Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability here. Follow `SECURITY.md` in the
repository root and report it privately to business@ai-edge.io. Remove
credentials, personal information, private paths, and proprietary source from
anything you share.

## The problem

What are you trying to do that PineWASM doesn't support today? Concrete
scripts or workflows beat abstract descriptions.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If the request is to implement a Pine Script® v6
feature, cite the relevant row in the repository's
`docs/pine-v6-coverage.md` if one exists, since that file lists the language
surfaces PineWASM covers and their boundaries.

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you've tried, and why they fall short.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and the coverage matrix for this request.
- [ ] This request contains no source code I lack the rights to share.
